C:PARTNERSGROUP.text: Global private markets investor investing in AVK data centre power.

C:RELATEDDIGITAL.text: Data center developer and investment platform building the Oracle campus in Saline Township, Michigan.

C:RUMGROUP.text: A Trump-linked company is reported to supply compute to Anthropic.

D:d001.text: Microsoft's 10-Q discloses its funding commitments to OpenAI, which it accounts for under the equity method.

D:d002.text: As part of its restructuring, OpenAI committed to buy additional Azure services from Microsoft.

D:d003.text: SoftBank completed its investment commitment to OpenAI by sending a final tranche, giving it a stake of about 11%.

D:d004.text: Under a letter of intent, Nvidia intends to invest in OpenAI as systems are deployed.

D:d005.text: Letter of intent to deploy at least 10 GW of Nvidia systems for OpenAI, with the first phase in 2H 2026 on Vera Rubin.

D:d006.text: OpenAI will deploy 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs, starting with MI450 in 2H 2026.

D:d007.text: AMD granted OpenAI warrants for up to 160M AMD shares, about 10% of the company, vesting as GPU deployment milestones are met.

D:d008.text: OpenAI and Broadcom will co-develop and deploy 10 GW of custom AI accelerators from 2026 to 2029.

D:d009.text: OpenAI confirmed it signed a roughly five-year compute purchase from Oracle under Stargate, covering 4.5 GW and starting in 2027.

D:d010.text: OpenAI signed an additional agreement with CoreWeave, with payment commitments running through April 2029, per a regulatory filing.

D:d011.text: Meta signed a compute agreement with CoreWeave running to 2031.

D:d012.text: Nvidia agreed to buy any CoreWeave cloud capacity left unsold through 2032.

D:d014.text: Microsoft was CoreWeave's largest customer, with commitments reported through 2030.

D:d015.text: Under a five-year GPU cloud contract, IREN hosts Nvidia GB300 capacity for Microsoft at Childress, Texas.

D:d016.text: IREN buys Nvidia GB300 servers from Dell for the Microsoft contract.

D:d017.text: Microsoft and Nebius have an AI compute deal.

D:d018.text: Meta and Nebius signed a five-year AI infrastructure agreement.

D:d019.text: Nebius entered definitive agreements for a private placement with participation from Accel, NVIDIA and Orbis-managed accounts.

D:d023.text: Amazon is making an additional investment in Anthropic.

D:d024.text: Google agreed to a new investment in Anthropic, confirmed to CNBC by an unnamed source.

D:d025.text: Anthropic will use up to one million Google TPUs, over 1 GW of capacity, in 2026.

D:d028.text: Anthropic's prospectus lists an expanded infrastructure deal with Microsoft running through May 2033, up from the earlier Azure commitment.

D:d029.text: Seven-year AWS agreement for Nvidia GB200/GB300 capacity.

D:d030.text: Reported six-year Google Cloud deal for Meta.

D:d032.text: Oracle reportedly bought about 400,000 Nvidia GB200s for the Abilene, Texas Stargate site.

D:d034.text: Nvidia invested in xAI's Series E, and the stake converted to SpaceX shares after the merger.

D:d035.text: SK Hynix will supply HBM/DRAM for Stargate, as part of combined Korean supply deals over four years.

D:d036.text: Samsung will supply HBM/DRAM for Stargate, as part of combined Korean supply deals over four years.

D:d047.text: Talen supplies 1.92 GW from the Susquehanna nuclear plant to AWS through 2042.

D:d049.text: Cipher and Fluidstack signed a 168 MW, 10-year AI hosting agreement.

D:d053.text: CoreWeave signed two long-term leases at Applied Digital, for 100 MW and 150 MW blocks over about 15 years, with an option for a third 150 MW block.

D:d054.text: CoreWeave leases the full 800 MW approved at Galaxy's Helios campus, Texas.

D:d055.text: CoreWeave signed for 500 MW of Core Scientific data center capacity over 12 years.

D:d059.text: AEP signed a supply agreement for up to 1 GW of Bloom fuel cells for AI data centers, with an initial 100 MW order placed and more expected in 2025.

D:d060.text: SoftBank will buy shares from OpenAI employees in a tender offer, per CNBC sources.

D:d061.text: Google signed a strategic partnership with Intersect Power and TPG Rise Climate to build colocated renewable power and storage with new US data centers, with Google as offtaker and anchor tenant; Google and TPG led an Intersect funding round.

D:d062.text: Non-binding Master Power Agreement to deploy 12 GW of Oklo Aurora powerhouses through 2044 for Switch data centers via PPAs; binding agreements to follow at project milestones.

D:d063.text: Nvidia took part as a strategic investor in xAI's Series C round.

D:d064.text: AMD took part as a strategic investor in xAI's Series C round.

D:d065.text: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners and Google signed a PPA for 250 MW of renewable energy in the Netherlands.

D:d066.text: Macquarie Asset Management will invest in Applied Digital's HPC subsidiary for a 15% stake, with initial funding for the 400MW Ellendale campus and a right of first refusal on further funding over 30 months.

D:d067.text: Bloomberg reports HPE won a deal to build AI servers for X, finalized in late 2024 after competing with Dell and Supermicro; HPE did not comment.

D:d068.text: Applied Digital's HPC subsidiary closed a financing with SMBC to repay the Macquarie Capital note and advance the Ellendale HPC Campus.

D:d069.text: Bloomberg reported xAI is preparing to buy AI servers with Nvidia GB200 GPUs from Dell, to be delivered this year, citing unnamed sources.

D:d070.text: As part of the five-year CoreWeave deal, OpenAI receives equity in CoreWeave.

D:d071.text: Meta will buy 100% of the output of RWE's 200 MWac Waterloo Solar project in Texas under a long-term PPA.

D:d072.text: AWS and HUMAIN announce a joint investment in AI infrastructure, AWS services, and AI training and talent development in Saudi Arabia and globally.

D:d073.text: Multi-year partnership in which Supermicro supplies ultra-dense GPU platforms and rack-scale liquid cooling for DataVolt's AI campuses in Saudi Arabia and the US.

D:d074.text: AMD signed a collaboration with HUMAIN to provide 500 MW of AI compute capacity for its data centers.

D:d075.text: Humain will receive 18,000 Nvidia GB300 Blackwell chips for a 500 MW AI data center.

D:d076.text: Two long-term PPAs for 650 MW of solar projects in Texas and Kansas (SPP market) support Meta's data centers.

D:d077.text: A J.P. Morgan-led consortium provided a construction loan, arranged by Newmark, for phase two of the Crusoe/Blue Owl/Primary Digital JV's 1.2 GW AI data center in Abilene, Texas.

D:d078.text: Meta invests in Scale AI for a 49% non-voting stake and hires CEO Alexandr Wang.

D:d079.text: Nebius will deploy around 9,000 Nvidia Blackwell B300 GPUs at Ark's Longcross Park campus in Surrey, its first UK entry, starting with about 4,000 Blackwell Ultra GPUs.

D:d080.text: CoreWeave will buy Core Scientific to meet AI power needs.

D:d081.text: Hydro Framework Agreement for Google to procure up to 3,000 MW of hydroelectric power from Brookfield, starting with a 20-year supply from the Holtwood and Safe Harbor plants.

D:d082.text: Founders Fund is reported to be committing to OpenAI's funding round.

D:d083.text: Dragoneer is reported to be committing to OpenAI's funding round.

D:d084.text: Samsung will supply Tesla with AI and autonomous driving chips under a contract effective July 26, 2025 through Dec 31, 2033, confirmed by Musk.

D:d085.text: Nvidia and YTL Power signed a strategic collaboration to use Nvidia GPUs to build AI data centers in Malaysia, plus a Malaysian sovereign LLM.

D:d086.text: Meta picked Pimco to lead debt financing for the Hyperion data center in Louisiana, which Meta leases under a 20-year lease with a guarantee.

D:d087.text: Meta and funds managed by Blue Owl formed a joint venture to develop and own Hyperion, with Blue Owl holding 80% and Meta keeping 20%.

D:d088.text: SoftBank recently closed a separate purchase of OpenAI employee shares.

D:d089.text: Blue Owl funds, Chirisa Technology Parks and Machine Investment Group closed a joint venture to fund CoreWeave's Lancaster, PA developments, which CoreWeave will lease; Blue Owl intends to fund further CTP developments.

D:d090.text: Macquarie Group led Fermi America's Series C preferred equity round for the HyperGrid AI private grid campus.

D:d091.text: Macquarie's Commodities and Global Markets business solely funded a senior loan facility, with part of it drawn at close.

D:d092.text: CoreWeave signed a new lease at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 2, increasing the total anticipated contracted lease revenue between the two.

D:d093.text: Nscale and Aker agreed to a five-year AI compute capacity arrangement from 2026 at a data center in Kvandal, Norway.

D:d094.text: OpenAI and CoreWeave expanded their existing agreement with a new expansion.

D:d095.text: Aker committed cash and in-kind Narvik land to Nscale's Series B round, in exchange for 9.3% ownership.

D:d096.text: Nvidia said it has invested in UK data center startup Nscale.

D:d097.text: The BlackRock/GIP-led AI Infrastructure Partnership, with Nvidia, Microsoft, MGX and others, will buy Aligned Data Centers from Macquarie Asset Management, with close expected 1H 2026 subject to regulatory approvals.

D:d098.text: Bloomberg reports Nvidia will invest in AI startup Poolside.

D:d099.text: Fermi America entered a long-term capital lease with Mobile Power Solutions for seven GE TM2500 gas turbines totaling 157.5 MW, delivered Q4 2025.

D:d100.text: Long-term PPA for 100 MW of solar energy in Grant County, Arkansas.

D:d101.text: Anthropic made a compute commitment of initially up to 1 GW on Nvidia Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems.

D:d102.text: Anthropic announced a commitment with Fluidstack days before the Microsoft deal, with details only mentioned in passing.

D:d103.text: Schneider Electric partnered with Switch on power modules and cooling systems.

D:d104.text: Schneider Electric agreed to supply Digital Realty with UPS and switchgear.

D:d105.text: TPG is investing in HyperVault, TCS's AI data center business.

D:d106.text: NIPSCO Generation will build up to 3 GW of gas generation and storage for Amazon data centers in northern Indiana under a 15-year deal paid for by Amazon; power starts Jan 1, 2027, rising to 2.4 GW by end of 2032.

D:d107.text: Crusoe is launch customer for Boom's Superpower natural gas turbines, ordering 29 units totaling 1.21 GW for AI data centers.

D:d108.text: NextEra and Google Cloud will develop at least three gigawatt-scale data center campuses with associated generation, and Google Cloud will provide AI services to NextEra.

D:d109.text: Hut 8 signed a 15-year, 245 MW IT lease at its River Bend campus in Louisiana, with renewal options and a right of first offer on up to 1,000 MW more.

D:d110.text: Google provides a financial backstop covering Fluidstack's obligations for the 15-year base lease term at River Bend.

D:d111.text: WhiteFiber signed a 10-year, 40 MW colocation agreement at its NC-1 campus in Madison, North Carolina.

D:d112.text: Alphabet will buy data center and power developer Intersect Power.

D:d113.text: Nvidia agreed to acquire Groq assets, though Groq describes the arrangement as a non-exclusive licensing agreement.

D:d114.text: SoftBank will acquire data center investment firm DigitalBridge.

D:d115.text: Cisco Investments joined xAI's Series E as a strategic investor supporting its compute buildout.

D:d116.text: Valor Compute Infrastructure raised funding, including from Apollo funds, to buy Nvidia GPUs and lease data center infrastructure to xAI under a triple net lease.

D:d117.text: Cerebras and OpenAI struck a multi-year compute deal, confirmed by Cerebras's CEO.

D:d118.text: Nvidia is making another investment in CoreWeave.

D:d119.text: Meta committed to buy fiber-optic cable from Corning through 2030 for its AI data centers, including Prometheus and Hyperion.

D:d120.text: Tesla agreed to invest in xAI Series E Preferred Stock as part of its financing round.

D:d121.text: Clearway signed new long-term PPAs of up to 20 years with Google for nearly 1.2 GW of carbon-free energy from projects in Missouri, Texas and West Virginia.

D:d122.text: SpaceX acquired xAI, combining the two private firms ahead of a planned IPO.

D:d123.text: Nvidia is investing in OpenAI's funding round.

D:d124.text: Dragoneer co-led Anthropic's Series G round; its individual amount was not stated.

D:d125.text: Founders Fund co-led Anthropic's Series G round; its individual amount was not stated.

D:d126.text: Blackstone is increasing its stake in Anthropic, per a source.

D:d127.text: Two 15-year solar PPAs totaling 1 GW, at Wichita and Mustang Creek in Texas, will supply Google data centers, with construction from Q2 2026.

D:d128.text: MUFG committed an equipment loan to fund three Siemens Energy gas turbines and repay a prior loan for Fermi America's campus.

D:d129.text: Marvell will acquire Lumentum in an all-stock deal, with close expected 1H 2028.

D:d130.text: HUMAIN invested in xAI's Series E, and its holdings later converted into SpaceX shares after the merger.

D:d131.text: Amazon completed its OpenAI investment in stages, in Q1, Q2 and after June 30, per an SEC filing.

D:d132.text: SoftBank closed the third and final tranche of its OpenAI commitment, funded by a bond sale.

D:d133.text: Meta and AMD signed a definitive multi-year, multi-generation agreement for Meta to deploy up to 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs, starting with custom MI450 in 2H 2026.

D:d134.text: AMD issued Meta a performance-based warrant for up to 160M AMD shares, vesting with GPU shipment milestones and stock price thresholds.

D:d135.text: Baker Hughes secured a 1.21 GW generator order to power Boom Supersonic's AI data center solution.

D:d136.text: Meta reportedly struck a deal with Google to access Google's TPU AI hardware, with terms not given.

D:d137.text: OpenAI expanded its AWS agreement over eight years, including at least 2 GW of Trainium compute.

D:d138.text: Nvidia is investing in Lumentum for US R&D and fab expansion, with a multi-year agreement including purchase commitments and future capacity access rights for laser components.

D:d139.text: Nvidia is investing in Coherent for US R&D and fab expansion, with a multiyear agreement including purchase commitments and capacity rights for laser and optical networking products.

D:d140.text: Nvidia will invest in Nebius as part of a strategic partnership to build gigawatt-scale AI factories.

D:d141.text: New five-year agreement for dedicated capacity including Nvidia Vera Rubin from early 2027, plus options for additional capacity purchases.

D:d142.text: A consortium led by BlackRock-owned GIP and EQT will take AES private, with close expected late 2026 or early 2027.

D:d143.text: Nscale will acquire AIPCorp, developer of the 8+ GW Monarch Compute Campus in West Virginia.

D:d144.text: Microsoft joins the additional tranche of OpenAI's funding round.

D:d145.text: TPG participates in OpenAI's additional funding commitment, according to CFO Sarah Friar.

D:d146.text: Sharon AI signs a five-year cloud capacity agreement and deploys 8,000 GPUs in an Australian data center.

D:d147.text: Morgan Stanley, MUFG, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan arrange a non-recourse delayed draw term loan maturing 2032, anchored by Blackstone Credit and secured by GPU clusters and Meta contracted revenue.

D:d148.text: CoreWeave and its customer expand their long-term AI cloud capacity agreement through December 2032, building on an earlier deal.

D:d149.text: Jane Street signs an AI cloud deal with CoreWeave and increases its stake in the company.

D:d150.text: Bloomberg reports Anthropic reached a deal with Broadcom; terms were not given.

D:d151.text: Marvell completed its purchase of Celestial AI in the first quarter of 2026.

D:d152.text: Amazon invests in Anthropic now, with further investment tied to commercial milestones, adding to its earlier investments.

D:d153.text: Anthropic commits to a 10-year deal on AWS, including Trainium chips, securing up to 5 GW of capacity.

D:d154.text: Jane Street bought CoreWeave equity alongside its compute deal.

D:d155.text: DataBank secured construction financing from banks led by MUFG for three Red Oak, Texas data center buildings leased by a hyperscaler.

D:d156.text: SpaceX exercised its option and bought Anysphere (Cursor) in an all-stock deal that closed August 14, 2026.

D:d157.text: Boost Run signed a purchase agreement with Dell for enterprise AI compute and storage hardware and software, with financing via Dell Financial Services.

D:d158.text: Google will invest in Anthropic, with an initial tranche now and the remainder contingent on performance milestones.

D:d159.text: An amended IPO filing raises Google's commitment compared with the first filing.

D:d160.text: Anan will establish and operate a 40 MW server farm for Crusoe in Afula, Israel, with plans to expand.

D:d161.text: MARA Holdings will buy Long Ridge Energy as part of an AI data center push.

D:d162.text: Nvidia gets a five-year option to buy up to 30M IREN shares, tied to a partnership to deploy up to 5 GW of AI infrastructure, mainly at Sweetwater, Texas.

D:d163.text: IREN will provide Nvidia managed GPU cloud services for internal AI workloads at Childress, Texas, under a five-year contract.

D:d164.text: Akamai and Anthropic signed a seven-year cloud infrastructure deal, Akamai's largest customer agreement ever.

D:d165.text: Nvidia and Corning signed a pact allowing Nvidia to invest in Corning via stock warrants.

D:d166.text: Nvidia invested in Marvell as part of a strategic partnership on silicon photonics.

D:d167.text: Google signed a 15-year power purchase agreement for 500 MW from Linea's new Duffy Solar Project in Matagorda, Texas, supporting its ERCOT data centers.

D:d168.text: New power purchase agreements signed in 2026 total 850 MW (500 MW Oklahoma, 200 MW Texas, 150 MW Mississippi); the partnership totals about 2,575 MW across nine states.

D:d169.text: Blackstone will invest equity in a new AI infrastructure company with Google, which supplies TPUs, with the first 500 MW online by 2027.

D:d170.text: Anthropic's IPO prospectus says amended SpaceX/xAI compute agreements run through 2029, and either party can exit on 90 days' notice after lock-ins end in January and March 2027.

D:d171.text: Nebius signed a deal with Bloom Energy; details were not given in the headline.

D:d172.text: Solar power purchase agreement for 200 MW AC from the Solstice project in LeFlore County, Oklahoma, to support Google data centers.

D:d173.text: Apollo-managed funds lead an initial capital solution in Broadcom's AI XPV Platform with Blackstone and banks, supporting Anthropic's compute expansion of more than 1 GW starting mid-2026.

D:d174.text: SpaceX signed a cloud compute deal with Google ahead of its IPO.

D:d175.text: Stark Power entered a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Sagebrush Infrastructure Partners, developer of five hyperscale data center campuses (about 5.6 GW) with co-located gas power plants.

D:d176.text: Google backstops lease payments tied to five US data centers Anthropic plans to use, underpinning the financing.

D:d177.text: Reflection AI pays SpaceX monthly from July 1, 2026 through 2029 for access to Nvidia GB300 systems at Colossus.

D:d178.text: Meta contracted about 1.6 GW of AI compute from Crusoe at its Childress and Warrenton sites, per Bloomberg.

D:d179.text: Realty Income will invest, funded over time, for a 45% stake in a three-asset Northern Virginia hyperscale data center portfolio through a joint venture with Cloud Capital and a global institutional investor.

D:d180.text: National Grid Ventures will invest for a 35% stake in Joulent, which develops Project Kilby, a 2.67 GW co-located power facility in West Texas with Chevron; final investment decision is expected in 2026.

D:d181.text: Microsoft signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with Chevron subsidiary Energy Forge One for a co-located natural gas power facility powering its new 2 GW Pecos, Texas data center campus.

D:d182.text: A 20-year lease covers a purpose-built AI campus at TeraWulf's Hawesville, Kentucky site, with about 401 MW of critical IT load, online from the second half of 2027.

D:d183.text: TeraWulf sold its 50.1% stake in the Abernathy joint venture, a 168 MW Texas facility, to a Fluidstack-led investor group.

D:d184.text: Nebius confirmed a compute deal through 2029 giving Reflection access to Nvidia GB300 clusters.

D:d185.text: AMD will invest in Anthropic alongside an AI server deal.

D:d186.text: Anthropic will deploy 2 GW of AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs in Helios racks, with the first GW in the first half of 2027.

D:d187.text: Bloom Energy will supply behind-the-meter fuel cell systems for a Nebius AI cloud data center development backed by Industrial Development Funding and Oaktree.

D:d188.text: UniTest signed a supply agreement with SK Hynix for HBM4 wafer test equipment.

D:d189.text: Verizon will provide dark fiber connecting Google's data centers, disclosed on its second-quarter call.

D:d190.text: Nvidia and SK Group signed letters of intent for a strategic relationship including long-term HBM supply and SK Telecom's 2 GW Nvidia-based AI data center.

D:d191.text: A five-year memorandum of understanding through 2030 covers HBM supply, foundry and advanced packaging.

D:d192.text: Nvidia will invest in Naver, which is building GPU data centers with 200 MW of capacity.

D:d193.text: Naver signed a contract with Brookfield for computing infrastructure funding for its AI factory.

D:d194.text: Anthropic's CEO confirmed a supply deal with Samsung at the summit; terms were not given.

D:d195.text: Anthropic's CEO confirmed a supply deal with SK Hynix at the summit; terms were not given.

D:d196.text: Reuters, citing a source, reports Nvidia will invest in Ilya Sutskever's AI startup.

D:d197.text: BlackRock-managed funds take 80% of a Meta venture developing the 1 GW El Paso, Texas data center campus, with Meta keeping 20%, partly debt-financed, and Meta receiving a distribution.

D:d198.text: The FT reported Nvidia entered lease agreements for Hut 8's 1 GW Beacon Point campus in Texas, with a 15-year base contract, and plans to lease the compute to neocloud providers.

D:d199.text: Morgan Stanley leads a bank group on bridge loan and revolver financing for Nexus Data Centers' Hubbard, Texas AI campus for Anthropic, in advanced talks.

D:d200.text: Google backstops Anthropic's obligations on four data-center leases and related power agreements underpinning the Hubbard, Texas financing, and is expected to receive about 20% equity in the project.

D:d201.text: Anthropic reportedly signed a six-year compute deal with Volta for a 133 MW Norway data center built with Bitdeer, running on Nvidia Vera Rubin systems.

D:d202.text: A 16-year colocation lease at Bitdeer's Tydal, Norway campus, with an optional 8-year extension, covers 133 MW of gross capacity.

D:d203.text: A 20-year lease covers 191 MW at Riot's Rockdale, Texas campus through June 2048, with extension options.

D:d204.text: Morgan Stanley provides an interim financing facility to fund early development and long-lead equipment at Riot's Rockdale data center campus.

D:d205.text: IBM to provide Together AI dedicated AI computing capacity on IBM Cloud using Nvidia HGX B300 systems, rolling out around Q1 2027.

D:d206.text: Nvidia is a strategic investor in River AI's funding round.

D:d207.text: AMD Ventures is a strategic investor in River AI's funding round.

D:d208.text: JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs underwrote a term loan to Volta.

D:d209.text: Nvidia to provide financing for OpenAI's Ohio data center, initially 4.25 GW with an option for 3.75 GW more, coming online in phases from 2028.

D:d210.text: Nvidia to invest in SB Energy as part of the Ohio OpenAI data center deal.

D:d211.text: SB Energy builds and manages the PORTS-Pike campus in Ohio, leased to OpenAI for 20 years.

D:d212.text: AMD is the first tenant at Riot's Rockdale data center campus under a 10-year agreement with three five-year extensions.

D:d213.text: Nvidia made a strategic investment in Lancium and will collaborate to deploy Nvidia AI infrastructure across Lancium's gigawatt-scale campuses.

D:d214.text: Nscale's S-1 shows a deal with Anthropic that still needs binding financing for GPUs and data-center infrastructure.

D:d215.text: Woodman placed a purchase order for Nvidia B300 GPU server clusters for its Yokohama AI project, with delivery by mid-November 2026.

D:d216.text: Blue Owl-managed funds led a compute equipment financing for IREN, made up of a senior secured term loan and senior secured notes, to buy Nvidia Blackwell Ultra GPUs for the Mackenzie campus in British Columbia, drawn in tranches.

D:d217.text: Anthropic's S-1 lists a deal with Lambda running until 2034, and Lambda must secure its facility lease in a timely manner.

D:d218.text: Fervo's Cape Station in Utah will supply 396 MW of geothermal power under a PPA for a potential Google data center, online 2028, with an option to expand by about 600 MW by June 2030.

D:d219.text: Nvidia agreed to buy Hugging Face.

D:d220.text: SLB is acquiring Kelvion, a maker of data center cooling equipment.

D:d221.text: Nscale and Figure formed a multi-year partnership with an initial compute commitment that scales up, using up to 100,000 Nvidia GPUs, with first deployment in 2H 2027 in Barstow, Texas.

D:d222.text: Qualcomm issued Amazon warrants for 25 million shares, expiring September 2036, vesting in tranches tied to commercial arrangements and Amazon purchases.

D:d223.text: Data center infrastructure partnership in which warrant vesting is tied to Amazon and AWS purchases of Qualcomm server chips and other technology.

D:d224.text: Verizon signed a supply agreement with Corning for over 80 million miles of optical fiber through 2032, for broadband and AI backbone networks.

D:d225.text: The Information reports Anthropic struck a compute deal with Trump-linked Rum Group; no terms beyond the headline.

D:d226.text: RWE signed a virtual PPA with Oracle for 433 MW from its existing Panther Creek I, II and III wind farms in West Texas, supporting Oracle's data center operations.

D:d227.text: New Era Energy & Digital secured a 20-year, 207 MW PPA with Vistra.

D:d228.text: Akamai announced a multi-year agreement with Anthropic for cloud computing capacity.

D:d229.text: Akamai grants Anthropic a warrant for up to a 5% stake alongside the cloud computing deal.

D:d230.text: 20-year PPA with Constellation for 690 MW from the Calvert Cliffs nuclear plant, including a 190 MW uprate coming online 2030-2032, plus a related retail supply agreement.

D:d231.text: Broadcom agreed to lend Anthropic funds via a convertible note to pay for infrastructure, per Anthropic's IPO prospectus.

D:d232.text: Anthropic disclosed five-year equipment leases involving Broadcom and financing entities.

D:d233.text: BofA, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley announced an SPV financing to buy Broadcom XPUs and networking to lease to Anthropic; Blackstone is sole second-lien provider and Broadcom gives residual value support.

D:d234.text: FT reports Oracle cancelled the five-year lease of up to 100,000 AI chips to Tencent in Southeast Asian data centers after US officials raised concerns; neither company confirmed.

D:d235.text: Multi-year deal in which Amazon licenses Synopsys IP and expands EDA tool use for AI chip design, while Synopsys adopts Bedrock and AWS compute.

D:d236.text: Oracle to pay for 125 to 250 MW of power that We Energies buys from the Point Beach nuclear plant, for its southeastern Wisconsin data centers.

D:d237.text: 20-year PPA for 890 MW from upgraded Constellation nuclear plants in PJM, enabling new Constellation investment.

D:d238.text: Separate long-term supply agreement for 2,700 MW from Constellation's existing plants in PJM, not tied to a specific source (15 years per other reports).

D:d239.text: Alphabet to directly finance a 564 MW natural gas and microgrid expansion by Black Hills in Cheyenne, Wyoming, including refundable advances; the contract runs to 2048.

D:d240.text: Five-year agreement for GlobalFoundries to produce silicon interposers for TSMC's CoWoS packaging in the US, with volume ramp in 1H 2028.

D:d241.text: Brookfield's financing framework for Bloom Energy was expanded to convert AI data center interest into financed projects.

D:d242.text: Apollo anchors Volta's debt deal for a Norway data center.

D:d243.text: Mainspring to provide up to 1.6 GW of linear generators to AEP through 2034, with a first tranche of 190 MW delivering from 2027.

D:d244.text: JPMorgan and MUFG arranged senior secured construction financing for two Vantage data center campuses, in Texas and Wisconsin, linked to Oracle's expansion.

D:d245.text: Nvidia gives KYEC a capacity reservation advance to build new US chip-testing facilities, with high-volume production targeted for April 2027.

D:d246.text: Market chatter: Nvidia and Tesla plan a combined investment in Samsung Electro-Mechanics; split not stated.

D:d247.text: Market chatter: Tesla and Nvidia plan a combined investment in Samsung Electro-Mechanics; split not stated.

D:d248.text: Verizon signed an AI infrastructure deal with AWS; details limited to the headline.

D:d249.text: SpaceX signed an equipment-finance lease with Apollo to pay for Nvidia GPUs for xAI, in tranches with lease schedules of about five years.

D:d250.text: 36-month reservation of Nvidia B300 GPU capacity at Forum Edge's Dallas facility.

D:d251.text: Canada to take an equity stake in Cohere; Cohere commits to jobs and to investing in Canadian computing infrastructure by 2030.

D:d252.text: AMD to invest in Meta's equity offering as the partnership covering up to 6 GW expands.

D:d253.text: USD.AI led and closed a four-year senior secured term loan for NexGen Cloud to finance 1,728 Nvidia B300 GPUs in Finland, with Silver Point and Victory Park as lenders.

D:d254.text: Nebius announced a 364-day bridge loan from Citi, with the rate stepping up every 90 days.

D:d255.text: GE Vernova to buy high-voltage grid equipment maker Trench Group from Triton Partners.

D:d256.text: Nvidia in talks to guarantee Nscale debt for the 460 MW West Virginia site for Anthropic; nothing signed.

D:d257.text: Nvidia invests in Meta's share sale, part of Meta's equity raise to fund its AI infrastructure build.

D:d258.text: AMD is reportedly effectively guaranteeing a loan so Crusoe can buy AMD chips, per The Information.

D:d259.text: KB Kookmin Bank is lead arranger for syndicated loans to a Brookfield SPC buying GPUs and AI infrastructure to supply Naver Cloud, as part of a larger project.

D:d260.text: Capital Power entered a long-term energy supply agreement with Meta for 250 MW of capacity and energy supporting a Meta data centre in Alberta.

D:d261.text: Qualcomm Ventures joined Hark's Series A round.

D:d262.text: Nvidia joined Hark's Series A round.

D:d263.text: AMD joined Hark's Series A round.

D:d264.text: Barber Lake lease extended to 20 years, combining an amended Fluidstack lease with a 10-year commitment from an AI lab.

D:d265.text: Vistra will be preferred power supplier to Helix Digital Infrastructure, backed by KKR, KIA and Nvidia, and committed funding to it.

D:d266.text: Drax, Brookfield and Radiant will develop a 1 GW+ AI data centre at Drax Power Station in North Yorkshire, with a first phase of up to 100MW.

D:d267.text: Intel Capital joined Hark's funding round alongside Nvidia and AMD Ventures; its individual amount was not stated.

D:d268.text: Micron is the sole subscriber of GlobalWafers' 10-year convertible bonds, alongside a 10-year long-term supply agreement.

D:d269.text: Xcel Energy and Google announced the 780 MW Project Skyway data center plan, tying new grid investments to AI computing needs.

D:d270.text: Amazon provides Anthropic a funding facility drawn as AWS delivers compute, with a large portion still undrawn at June 30.

D:d271.text: X-energy and AEP signed a joint development agreement for a proposed 12-unit, 960 MW Xe-100 plant in Sullivan County, Indiana.

D:d272.text: Amazon will help fund development of the 960 MW X-energy/AEP Indiana plant and plans to buy the power.

D:d273.text: Williams has a 400 megawatt power deal with Meta, credited for its optimistic guidance.

D:d274.text: Applied Materials is doubling its stake in Besi to about 20% and partners with it on hybrid bonding.

D:d275.text: Pinnacle West expects to file with the Arizona regulator a 25-year power deal to supply TSMC 1.88 GW.

D:d276.text: Eaton agreed to acquire COL Group, expanding European manufacturing and power distribution for data center and utility markets.

D:d277.text: Eaton completed its acquisition of Boyd Thermal, adding liquid cooling for data centers.

D:d278.text: Google signed three credit support agreements backstopping Anthropic's 20-year, roughly 401 MW leases at TeraWulf's Hawesville, Kentucky campus, effective once data halls commence.

D:d279.text: Soluna and Applied Digital will form a JV for a 50 MW AI/HPC data center at Dorothy 3, Briscoe County, Texas; Applied Digital owns 51% and funds development, while Soluna contributes land and power assets, subject to approvals including a county tax abatement.

D:d280.text: Core Scientific will provide 529 MW of data-center capacity; AMD leased 377 MW itself and backed a cloud provider taking 152 MW, letting AMD secure up to 2.5 GW for customers.

D:d281.text: AMD received warrants to buy up to 30M Core Scientific shares, with rights increasing as more capacity is leased.

D:d282.text: Bloomberg reports Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance ordered about 6M Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 chips combined, but expect to receive only a small fraction soon.

D:d283.text: AMD entered a definitive cash-and-stock agreement to acquire Taalas, a developer of specialized inference silicon, including some contingent payments.

D:d284.text: The Department of Energy gave Constellation a conditional loan commitment to expand nuclear output.

D:d285.text: An AI lab, reportedly Anthropic per a CoinDesk headline, signed a 15-year lease with Riot for 910 MW of IT capacity.

D:d286.text: A 20-year power purchase agreement covers a 702 MW Bloom fuel-cell project with carbon capture near Cheyenne, Wyoming, in which AEP plans to invest.

D:d287.text: Nvidia agreed to guarantee some of Nscale's obligations under the Ionic lease in return for warrants, per Nscale's S-1.

D:d288.text: Statements of work signed from September 2025 to April 2026 run through December 2033, subject to delivery requirements; Microsoft declined an option to expand the Texas contract.

D:d289.text: Digital Realty and Goodman's jointly owned trust made an offer for up to 9.9% of NEXTDC shares; fill and payment are not confirmed.

D:d290.text: Core Scientific closed its acquisition of Polaris DS, expanding its HPC and AI data center footprint.

D:d291.text: NTT DATA agreed with Bloom Energy to deploy 900 MW of onsite fuel cell power across multiple global data center projects, designed to expand toward gigawatt scale.

D:d292.text: Flex acquired liquid cooling company JetCool Technologies to strengthen its data center and power portfolio for AI workloads.

D:d293.text: Bloomberg, citing people familiar with the matter, reports Blackstone recently closed an equity stake in Texas data center firm Lancium.

D:d294.text: Vertiv's Chinese subsidiary acquired certain assets and technologies of chiller maker BiXin Energy Technology (Suzhou) to broaden Vertiv's chiller portfolio for AI and high-performance compute.

D:d295.text: SoftBank invested in Cipher Mining in a deal giving it a period of exclusivity to acquire the Barber Lake site, possibly for OpenAI's Stargate.

D:d296.text: SoftBank will acquire Arm-based datacenter CPU developer Ampere Computing for cash, with Carlyle and Oracle selling their stakes; closing is expected in 2H 2025, subject to regulatory approvals.

D:d297.text: Duke Energy acquired 11 GE Vernova 7HA natural gas turbines for growing data center and manufacturing power demand, adding to eight acquired previously.

D:d298.text: Samsung signed a definitive agreement to buy FläktGroup, a German HVAC and data center cooling maker, from Triton.

D:d299.text: ArcLight and DigitalBridge committed new capital to Takanock, a data center power infrastructure provider.

D:d300.text: Samsung Ventures invested in GRC, an immersion cooling provider for data centers.

D:d301.text: Vertiv completed its acquisition of Great Lakes Data Racks & Cabinets, adding rack, cabinet and integration solutions for high-density AI data centres.

D:d302.text: Talen is buying two gas plants, the 1.058GW Moxie Freedom in Pennsylvania and 1.875GW Guernsey County in Ohio, from Caithness and BlackRock, with closing expected in Q4 2025.

D:d303.text: Nvidia and Schneider Electric partnered to co-develop cooling, power, building management and control systems for AI factories.

D:d304.text: AEP subsidiary Indiana Michigan Power and Google filed a special customer contract with Indiana's regulator for clean capacity and demand response at the Fort Wayne data center, pending approval.

D:d305.text: Applied Digital led the Series A1 funding round for Corintis, which makes microfluidic chip cooling for AI data centers.

D:d306.text: Accelsius closed a Series B funding round led by Johnson Controls.

D:d307.text: Legrand acquired load bank provider Avtron, its fifth data center acquisition in 2025.

D:d308.text: Meta acquired AI chip startup Rivos, which had developed a CUDA-compatible RISC-V processor.

D:d309.text: Firmus and CDC Data Centres formed a strategic alliance for Australian AI cloud capacity, starting at Southgate Melbourne with 18,500 Nvidia GB300 GPUs and scalable to 1.6 GW through 2028.

D:d310.text: VoltaGrid contracted INNIO to deliver 2.3 GW of Jenbacher power infrastructure, in 92 power racks of about 25 MW each, for AI data centers, INNIO's largest contract ever.

D:d311.text: CleanSpark and immersion cooling firm Submer partnered on an infrastructure platform integrating power generation, data center development and AI-service delivery.

D:d312.text: Vertiv completed its acquisition of PurgeRite.

D:d313.text: Flex and LG Electronics will jointly develop integrated modular cooling solutions for gigawatt-scale AI data centers.

D:d314.text: Daikin Applied Americas acquired Chilldyne, a direct-to-chip liquid cooling firm.

D:d315.text: Lambda will lease 21 MW at Prime's LAX01 AI-ready data center in Vernon, California, for Nvidia Blackwell infrastructure.

D:d316.text: HUMAIN and Global AI partnered to build large-scale AI data center and compute capacity in the US using Nvidia infrastructure.

D:d317.text: GIC, ADIA and an institutional investor are investing in Vantage to fund the Johor campus buyout and scale its Asia-Pacific platform.

D:d318.text: Trane Technologies signed a definitive agreement to acquire Stellar Energy Digital, maker of turnkey liquid-to-chip data center cooling plants and CDUs.

D:d319.text: Legrand joined Accelsius' Series B funding round.

D:d320.text: Firmus secured a debt financing facility led by Blackstone and Coatue to roll out its AI factory platform across Australia under Project Southgate.

D:d321.text: Trane Technologies agreed to acquire liquid cooling firm LiquidStack, building on its 2023 minority investment.

D:d322.text: Johnson Controls closed its acquisition of Alloy Enterprises, a thermal management firm for data centres.

D:d323.text: Submer acquired Radian Arc, a sovereign telco-focused GPU cloud infrastructure-as-a-service provider.

D:d324.text: Submer and Anant Raj Cloud signed a memorandum of understanding to develop data centers in India.

D:d325.text: AES and Google signed 20-year power purchase agreements for co-located generation at a new Google data center in Wilbarger County, Texas, with AES owning and operating the assets and providing energy management services.

D:d326.text: Vertiv and Generate Capital are collaborating on a Bring Your Own Power & Cooling offering combining Vertiv equipment with Generate's financing and ownership for US data centers.

D:d327.text: Smiths acquired DRC Heat Transfer, a data center power and cooling equipment maker, to integrate into Flex-Tek.

D:d328.text: Blackstone Energy Transition Partners entered a definitive agreement to acquire a majority stake in thermal management firm Advanced Cooling Technologies.

D:d329.text: Ecolab completed its acquisition of CoolIT Systems, a direct liquid cooling maker.

D:d330.text: Vertiv completed its acquisition of Italian heat-rejection specialist ThermoKey on June 12, 2026.

D:d331.text: Legrand acquired Keydak, a Guangzhou rack manufacturer.

D:d332.text: Legrand acquired UK power distribution specialist TES, which earns over half its revenue from data centers.

D:d333.text: Flex agreed to acquire Electrical Power Products for cash to expand power control systems for data centers and utilities.

D:d334.text: Vertiv acquired BMarko Structures, a US structural fabrication provider, for prefab data center infrastructure.

D:d335.text: Molex agreed to acquire Teramount, developer of detachable fiber-to-chip connectivity for co-packaged optics.

D:d336.text: PIMCO-managed funds anchored fixed-rate, long-term debt financing for Related Digital's Saline Township, Michigan campus built for Oracle.

D:d337.text: Blackstone-affiliated funds committed equity alongside Related Digital to fund the Oracle campus in Saline Township, Michigan.

D:d338.text: Vertiv acquired cold-plate design specialist Strategic Thermal Labs to strengthen its liquid cooling offering.

D:d339.text: NextEra will buy Dominion Energy in an all-stock deal, uniting utilities serving AI data center demand including northern Virginia.

D:d340.text: I Squared Capital will buy ten data centers totaling 53 MW from Cogent for cash to seed a new AI inference colocation platform, with closing expected in Q3 2026.

D:d341.text: Wesco completed its acquisition of Newark Engineering Group, a Singapore data center cooling provider.

D:d342.text: TDK will acquire Fabric8Labs for upfront cash plus a multi-year earnout, subject to regulatory approvals.

D:d343.text: Schneider Electric and Foxconn partnered to co-develop and scale AI data center infrastructure, with production of integrated systems starting later this year.

D:d344.text: SWI Group acquired a significant stake in Genesis Digital Assets, which holds 1.3 GW of grid connections and plans to convert from crypto mining to HPC and AI.

D:d345.text: Montana-Dakota Utilities signed an electric service agreement to power Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 3 AI campus near Center, North Dakota, with 430 MW at full capacity and operations from August 2027.

D:d346.text: Flex expanded its manufacturing partnership with Cerebras to scale production of CS-3 systems in Milpitas, with about seven times the capacity through 2026.

D:d347.text: A memorandum of understanding targets energy-as-a-service for AI data centers, deploying 100MW of Delta Solid-State Transformers and scaling to gigawatt level.

D:d348.text: Partners Group invests in AVK to support data centre power.

D:d349.text: WhiteFiber becomes exclusive GPU infrastructure operator for 100 MW of Krambu's planned high-density capacity, starting in 2027.

D:d350.text: Molex makes a strategic investment in CAEPlus, developer of BoundaryCool active liquid cooling for AI data centers.

D:d351.text: Madison Air will acquire ebm-papst, maker of airflow, fan and motor technology for data center cooling, with closing expected around the end of 2026, subject to approvals.

D:d352.text: Nvidia makes a minority investment in Cloverleaf Infrastructure as part of a strategic partnership on AI factory infrastructure development.

D:d353.text: nVent will acquire Maverick Power, with part of the consideration tied to the company's 2027-2028 performance.

D:d354.text: A SuperX subsidiary signed a supply agreement with Ezisight and received an initial purchase order for 128 B300 AI server clusters, to be delivered in Australia in Q4 2026.

D:d355.text: Vertiv will acquire UtilityInnovation Group, a microgrid and behind-the-meter power firm, paying cash at closing plus an earnout based on future earnings.

D:d356.text: Flex signed a definitive agreement to acquire EPC Power, a power conversion provider for data center and grid uses, with closing expected in Q4 2026.

D:d357.text: Liteon bought a 25% stake in DCX, a Polish liquid cooling firm.

D:d358.text: Blackstone funds signed a definitive agreement to acquire liquid cooling components maker Flow Control Holdings from Audax, which keeps a minority stake; closing is expected in Q4.

D:d359.text: AirJoule acquired BitSink, a cooling and electrical distribution firm, for an upfront payment plus a contingent payment.

D:d360.text: Vertiv completed its acquisition of King Environmental Services, which provides fluid management and load-testing for liquid-cooled data centers.

D:d361.text: SPX Technologies acquires FIS Water, adding water management and flow-control brands for data center cooling.

D:d362.text: Samsung Electronics and five affiliates invest in Helix, a company established by KKR.

D:d363.text: IREN taps Dell for Nvidia Blackwell servers under a supply contract.

D:d364.text: HPE secures its first AMD Helios order, placed by Vultr.

D:d365.text: LG Electronics USA signed a long-term agreement to supply chillers to AIR Control Concepts for AI data center projects exceeding 5 GW in the US and Canada.

D:d366.text: The Information reports, citing three people with knowledge, that Nvidia plans to invest in inference chip startup d-Matrix; the report is unconfirmed.

D:d367.text: Eole will acquire AI data centre builder WOODMAN as a wholly owned subsidiary through a share exchange, approved by the board on Oct 15 and effective Nov 30.

D:d368.text: Bluu Unit acquired Space Engineering, adding packaged systems and data center cooling technologies and entry into the UK and Hungary.

D:d369.text: General Compute will buy Positron's Atlas inference systems and has committed to buy its next-generation Titan systems.

D:d370.text: Trane Technologies signed a definitive agreement to acquire Cancoil Thermal Corporation, a heat-transfer products maker serving data centers among other markets.

D:d371.text: Acuity signed a definitive agreement to buy Parameter Technologies, a data center leak detection and monitoring company, funded by borrowing and cash, with closing expected in fiscal Q2 2027.

D:d372.text: Two parties signed a non-binding MOU to collaborate on AI computing systems, GPU clusters and data center infrastructure, exploring a roadmap of up to 100 MW without binding commitments.

D:d373.text: Omen AI acquired Aquatic Labs for cash and stock to add cooling-fluid sensor technology, and founder Allan Adams becomes chief science officer.

D:d374.text: A three-year strategic agreement covers supply of silicon and silicon carbide power semiconductors for Vertiv's power products, including 800 VDC.

D:d375.text: Hyosung Goodsprings secured contracts to supply cooling pumps for SKT's 100 MW Ulsan AI data center.

D:d376.text: DigitalBridge will acquire ArcLight Capital, a private equity firm focused on power and infrastructure.

D:d377.text: Anthropic takes over OnePWR Solutions' existing Caterpillar gas generator orders totaling 1.7 GW, plus engineering and construction work, agreed in late September, per Reuters.

D:d378.text: Founders Fund co-led Fractile's Series C funding round.

D:d379.text: Dragoneer joined Fractile's Series C funding round.

D:d380.text: BlackRock joined Fractile's Series C funding round.

D:d381.text: Google buys a Crusoe site for its first Wyoming data center.

D:d382.text: Trinity Capital commits debt financing to Phononic to expand growth and manufacturing of solid-state cooling for AI data centers.

D:d383.text: Google signed a geothermal power purchase agreement for 50 MW from Quaise's Project Obsidian in Oregon, starting as early as 2030, supporting its The Dalles data center.

D:d384.text: Vertiv and Solenis form a strategic partnership combining Vertiv thermal infrastructure with Solenis fluid management for liquid cooling in AI data centers.
